newsitem.title: UK: Henry Boot sees flat sales, cites weak market.
newsitem.headline: Henry Boot sees flat sales, cites weak market.

text.p: Henry Boot & Sons Plc, reporting a fall in first-half turnover, said on Tuesday it expected its sales to run at current levels for the foreseeable future.
The construction services and investment firm's first-half pretax profits rose to 2.9 million stg from 2.7 million stg last time, but turnover fell to 75.5 million stg from 86.7 million.
The company attributed the fall to unacceptable margins among construction contracts due to over-capacity and to significantly reduced public expenditure.
"Against this background, it is likely that turnover will continue to run at current levels for the foreseeable future," the company said in a statement.
It added that it had not yet made any significant headway in pursuing monies owed to it by slow-paying clients.
"In view of the unsatisfactory conditions that prevail in our markets, particularly construction, we can only maintain our customary caution with regard to the year-end," Henry Boot said.
